feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Daniela Brozzoni has expressed interest in taking on the role of a BIP editor, highlighting her relevant experience and ongoing commitment to the Bitcoin ecosystem. She is the author of BIP 394, which introduces the rawtr() descriptor and was recently merged. Additionally, she has contributed improvements to BIP 360, demonstrating her familiarity with the BIP process and standards.
Currently pursuing a master's degree specializing in blockchain, Daniela dedicates much of her remaining free time to reviewing contributions for Bitcoin Core, as evidenced by her activity on [GitHub](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls?q=is%3Apr+reviewed-by%3Ajeanpablojp). She is prepared to allocate 10 to 15 hours per week over the next 18 months—the duration of her academic program—with the intention of possibly extending her involvement beyond that period.
She has indicated a willingness to begin her editorial responsibilities by focusing on new BIPs that require detailed review. Daniela expresses a strong desire to learn from existing editors and adhere to their guidance throughout her tenure. Her message also includes an expression of gratitude towards Murch and the team of current editors for their ongoing efforts within the community.
